interpretation: DAF directory supplies INIT, INTLEN, RSIZE and N. Separate binary64 subtraction then division; signed truncation equals floor for nonnegative quotient. One-based record is min(trunc(q_hat)+1,N), followed by integer DAF addressing. MADD here is integer, not floating-point FMA.

evaluation_instructions.instruction: chbval: fsub d0, d0, d1
chbval: fdiv d0, d0, d2
chbval: fadd d1, d0, d0
chbval: fnmsub d2, d1, d2, d4
chbval: fadd d2, d2, d5
chbval: fnmsub d0, d0, d2, d3
chbval: fadd d0, d0, d1
chbint: fsub d0, d0, d1
chbint: fdiv d0, d0, d2
chbint: fadd d1, d0, d0
chbint: fnmsub d6, d1, d6, d16
chbint: fadd d6, d6, d2
chbint: fnmsub d3, d0, d6, d3
chbint: fadd d1, d3, d1
chbint derivative: fmul d2, d1, d4
chbint derivative: fmadd d2, d3, d5, d2
chbint derivative: fsub d2, d2, d7
chbint derivative: fmadd d0, d0, d2, d6
chbint derivative: fsub d0, d0, d4
chbint derivative: fdiv d0, d0, d1

evaluation_scope: Inspected position recurrence in chbval_ and chbint_, plus chbint_ derivative recurrence. Each position product-minus-previous term is fused, followed by a separate coefficient addition. Derivative steps multiply twice-normalized-time by the previous derivative, fuse 2 times the previous position plus that rounded product, then subtract the following derivative. The final derivative fuses normalized-time times derivative plus position, subtracts the next derivative, then divides by record radius. SPKE03 calls chbval_ for six stored components; SPKE02 calls chbint_ for three position polynomials and derivatives. Bitwise supplied-record velocity replay and sampled exact-oracle checks do not bound uniform derivative rounding error.
scope: Static successful reader, position-evaluation and type-2 derivative paths in this exact build. Assumes valid directory, nonnegative finite in-range quotient, no signed integer overflow and declared floating-point mode. Does not certify live dispatch, continuous FPCR, DAF internals, segment priority, uniform polynomial evaluation error, center-chain summation or spacecraft safety.
